mods.name: Shenzoo: The Long March Home
mods.summary: Alpha faction mod by PassingbyPosts: play as Shenzoo, a new Cathayan legendary lord stranded in Norsca, in a story campaign about finding her way home.
mods.description:
Shenzoo, the youngest daughter of the Dragon Emperor, starts stranded on the Norscan coast after her fleet is wrecked while she chases a vision of an evil stirring in the west. You rally her scattered forces, make uneasy alliances and recruit former enemies on a long march back towards Cathay.

The mod adds Shenzoo as a new legendary lord with a unique campaign start, custom voice lines, a faction mechanic for talking to companions in a light-novel style, a narrative campaign and new battles. It is an alpha meant for feedback and bug hunting: Cathayan buildings are usable for now, but the final version is meant to keep you short of troops.

The Workshop page requires Mixu's Unlocker, MCT and Variant Selector. On Discord the story is described as running until Valkia is defeated and Loi is collected from the Compendium; a Russian version from 2026-06-04 exists and must be loaded above the original.
features: Play as Shenzoo, a new legendary lord with a unique start
Custom voice lines and a companion dialogue mechanic
Requires Mixu's Unlocker, MCT and Variant Selector

mods.name: More Lustful Daemonettes Varieties (Standalone)
mods.summary: Compilation of several daemonette model sets mixed with the vanilla ones, from androgynous to more female types, plus lord variety for Disciple armies.
mods.description:
A merged compilation of daemonette models: the Female Daemonettes and LewdIvan's daemonettes (original and thicker versions) are mixed with the vanilla models, giving a wider range from androgynous to more female types, with some sparsely clothed extra models to match the Slaanesh depiction. It also gives Disciple armies more lord variety. Credits go to The Rogue Roman and LewdIvan for the models.

It is compatible with Variant Selector, and the Eternal Entourage of Slaanesh reskin is already included, so that mod is not needed separately. The author explains how to remove the futa variants with RPFM for players who do not want them.

Published on Steam by Railgun; on Discord it was posted by CassieVoter (V4_0). The page says it was updated for game version 8.0.x.
features: Mixes several daemonette model sets with the vanilla ones
Eternal Entourage of Slaanesh reskin included

mods.name: More Animation
mods.summary: Battle setting tweak that makes matched-combat animations happen much more often. Adds no animations of its own; save-game compatible.
mods.description:
More Animation changes battle settings so that melee uses matched combat (paired, synchronised animations) far more often instead of separate attacks. The chance values for matched combat are raised to the maximum, the hit-point thresholds for starting and continuing a matched fight are lowered, and premature kills are removed so that the killing hit lines up with the death animation.

It does not add new animations, so it should stay compatible with mods that do. The author describes it as save-game compatible and compatible with everything. It is a general gameplay/visual tweak, not a lewd mod.
features: Matched-combat chance raised to the maximum
Lower hit-point thresholds for matched fights
